text:
When I open the door of myself in objects:
who steals my blood, what is mine, what is real?
Who hurls me into the void
when I breathe? Who
is my executioner inside myself?

O Time. Many-faced.
Face multiplied by yourself.
Emerge from the origins of music. Emerge
from my weeping. Tear off your laughing mask.
Wait for me to kiss you, convulsive beauty.
Wait for me at the sea's door. Wait for me
in the object I love eternally.

translation.title: When I Open the Door of Myself in Objects...
